paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Finance Analyst, GTM Finance role at CoreWeave. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I've been focusing my search on the finance side of AI infrastructure, and this team sits right where it gets practical: working out the economics of each commercial proposal while keeping the financial integrity of the deal.

At Lenovo I built financial models and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget changes. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels, building models to evaluate how to deploy $10M and benchmarking past allocations, which identified 30% in efficiency gains. Earlier, at Thomson Reuters, I ran reconciliations with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting.

That lines up with modeling deal economics and P&L impact, then giving Sales partners a clear recommendation. I don't have deal desk or cloud pricing experience, and my valuation work (DCF, comps and an LBO on J.M. Smucker) is MBA coursework, so I'd be learning GPU economics on the job. I'm careful with detail and I write plainly for the people making the call. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
